remarks: Welcome to your dream home, perfectly situated on a serene cul-de-sac with level yard on .79acres near downtown Westport! This charming residence effortlessly combines modern elegance with cozy comfort, offering 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms. As you step into the welcoming foyer, you'll immediately feel at home. The bright and airy living room features a stunning wood-burning fireplace and is drenched in natural light, making it the perfect space for entertaining guests or relaxing on quiet evenings. Adjacent, the formal dining room provides ample space for hosting memorable gatherings.  At the heart of the home, you'll find the inviting eat-in kitchen, complete with a peninsula and a generous casual dining area with door to deck. This space is designed for both functionality and comfort. French door from the living room lead to a charming screened porch, an ideal spot for morning coffee or intimate dinners, all while overlooking a beautifully private yard.The main level offers well-appointed bedrooms, including a hall bathroom. The primary en-suite bedroom is a true sanctuary, offering peace and relaxation. On the lower level, you'll discover a cozy family room with another wood-burning fireplace, a guest bedroom with a full bath, and a spacious laundry area with plenty of storage.  Step outside to your oversized deck and expansive yard, perfect for outdoor entertaining and play. This home is conveniently located near top-rated schools,shopping, beaches,more.
